profile.headline: Software Developer, Vulnerability Management Team at Cisco
profile.summary:
Highly proficient in Web-based programming and technologies.  Experienced in Linux/Unix system administration. Skilled in developing creative solutions to problems using a variety of programming languages.  Proficient in designing clear, intuitive user-interfaces.  Demonstrated ability to solve problems with little or no guidance.  Comfortable working individually or within a team.  Skilled at writing robust, well-documented, customizable, easily-maintainable programs. Dependable, conscientious employee who enjoys helping people solve their problems.

Specialties: Perl, PHP, HTML/DHTML, CSS, JavaScript, TCL, Unix shell scripting, MySQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, Apache, Microsoft IIS, MediaWiki, WordPress, Linux (Ubuntu, Red Hat, Debian, Gentoo), Solaris 8, Digital UNIX, Windows, MacOS

positions.title: Software Developer, Security Incident Response Team
IT Manager
positions.description: At GRBC, I handle all aspects of the church's IT needs.  As the webmaster, I designed www.grbc.net from the ground up, integrated it with MySQL, and maintain it along with several other sites we host.  As system administrator, I installed, configured, and maintain the church's Ubuntu Linux server which serves as a webserver (Apache), mail server (Postfix), file server (Samba), audio server (Helix), firewall and internet gateway (iptables).  As security administrator, I installed and maintain the church's VPN server, SSL certificates, and secure communication needs.  As support specialist, I troubleshoot and resolve all problems related to the church's PCs running a variety of versions of Windows.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description: For over 15 years I have operated my own consulting business, providing a variety of IT services.  I have created database-driven websites, written web applications, setup and administered Linux and Windows servers, installed and configured firewalls, setup LANs, repaired broken PCs (hardware and software), recovered lost files, and provided training services.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description: In my role as programmer analyst at CenturyTel, I developed a number of web-based applications to support CenturyTel's Network Operations groups.  I also installed, customized and maintained several open-source applications such as Routers2 and dotProject for use within the Operations groups.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Performed requirement analysis, prototyping, development, and maintenance of applications written in PHP, Perl and MySQL. Performed system administration tasks on a variety of Solaris- and Linux-based systems.

positions.title: Senior E-Commerce Developer
positions.description: Performed requirement analysis, prototyping, development, and maintenance of applications written in Perl and MySQL, and TCL using Vignette StoryServer 5 and SQL Server on the back end.

positions.title: Web Manager
positions.description: Responsible for the development and daily maintenance of the corporate intranet.  Wrote custom Perl CGI applications and UNIX tools for multiple departments within the company.

company.name: Blue Cross Blue Shield, North Carolina

positions.title: Information Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for the design, building, content creation, and maintenance of many clients' websites.  Wrote CGI applications and a number of custom tools (both Internet- and non-Internet-related) using:
* TCL
* Perl
* JavaScript
* UNIX shell scripts
* PHP
* C.

Installed and customized Apache, Microsoft IIS, Netscape, and proprietary web servers.  Integrated websites and databases to build customer login and problem tracking applications.

positions.title: Consultant, Technical Assistance Center
positions.description: Provided technical support for laptop and desktop computers and UNC-administered central systems.  Diagnosed and repaired damaged Macintosh and IBM computers, floppy disks and hard disks.  Initiated virus-prevention methods in campus computer laboratories.  Advised clients with computer purchasing questions.  Wrote documentation for anti-virus and terminal emulation software.  Wrote web pages and tutorials on obtaining and using Internet accounts.  Installed hardware, including motherboards, hard drives, memory, and expansion cards.
